guidance: Reuse this context for DOM-targeted actions and supplementary reads. Human intervention or main-document replacement requires sync. Actions using an iframe target or precondition require a fresh sync when frame documents change. Use explicit expect checks for business facts such as price, recipient or record ID. Scripts, untargeted keys and visual clicks require this sync's top-level observation_id (not observation.observation_id) and retain strict content checks. Never replay an uncertain action; inspect its result first.
